description: Authorizes a HubSpot deal's dealstage and/or amount update only with a signed approval from a trusted person for that deal. The dealstage transition must also be on an allowed forward path through the pipeline, as verified against the real deal.

unboundSignalReasons.dealStageChangeRequested: Derived by comparing currentDealStage to proposedDealStage (both bound facts); a computed decision fact, not a raw Intent field to bind independently.
unboundSignalReasons.dealStageTransitionAllowed: Derived by checking the requested stage transition against an allowed-transitions graph; a computed decision fact with no Intent-side equivalent.

outcome.reason: Deal update rejected because the requested dealstage transition is not on an allowed forward path.
Deal update authorized with a verified approval for this deal, and the dealstage transition (if any) is on an allowed path.
Deal update rejected. Every deal update needs a signed approval for this deal in signals.approvalArtifact, with dealUpdateApproved true, and every other policy condition satisfied.
